Package io.telekom.orchest.scheduling.spi

Interface ScheduledTaskStore

public interface ScheduledTaskStore
Storage SPI for the task scheduler.

The scheduler depends only on this contract — adopters plug in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, etc. by providing a single implementation. The interface is intentionally narrow and built around atomic single-document operations so it can be implemented on any backend that supports compare-and-set on a row, including stores without multi-document transactions.

Distributed-correctness contract — implementations must guarantee:

  • upsertByBusinessKey(TaskScheduleRequest) is atomic on (type, businessKey) (one winner; no duplicate rows).
  • claimDue(String, Instant, Duration, int) hands a given task to at most one caller per lease window. The implementation should use an atomic find-and-modify / SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED equivalent on each row, in triggerAt ASC order, filtered by state == PENDING AND triggerAt &le; now or a stale lease (state == RUNNING AND leaseUntil &lt; now).
  • completeAndDelete(String, long), fail(String, long, Instant, String) and markDead(String, long, String) are no-ops when the expectedVersion does not match (lease was stolen) — they must not overwrite a newer state.

Lease semantics — when a worker claims a task, the store stamps ownerId and bumps leaseUntil to now + leaseDuration. The worker must call complete or fail before leaseUntil elapses; if it crashes, another dispatcher will see a stale lease and re-claim the row on its next poll.

  • Method Details

    • insert

      ScheduledTask insert(TaskScheduleRequest request)
      Insert a new task. Used when no business key is supplied (always creates a new row).

    • upsertByBusinessKey

      ScheduledTask upsertByBusinessKey(TaskScheduleRequest request)
      Insert-or-update keyed by (type, businessKey). Atomic on the pair.

      If an existing row is found, its triggerAt, payload, state and attempts are reset; id is preserved.

    • claimDue

      List<ScheduledTask> claimDue(String ownerId, Instant now, Duration leaseDuration, int batchSize)
      Atomically claim up to batchSize due tasks for the given owner. A task is "due" if:
      • state == PENDING && triggerAt <= now; or
      • state == RUNNING && leaseUntil < now (stale lease — original worker died).

      Each returned task has its state flipped to RUNNING, ownerId set to ownerId, and leaseUntil set to now + leaseDuration.

    • completeAndDelete

      void completeAndDelete(String id, long expectedVersion)
      Mark the task complete and delete the row. No-op if expectedVersion mismatches.

    • fail

      void fail(String id, long expectedVersion, Instant nextTriggerAt, String lastError)
      Reset a task back to PENDING for retry at nextTriggerAt, recording the last error for forensics. No-op if expectedVersion mismatches.

    • markDead

      void markDead(String id, long expectedVersion, String lastError)
      Move a task to DEAD after attempts are exhausted. No-op on version mismatch.

    • deleteByBusinessKey

      void deleteByBusinessKey(String type, String businessKey)
      Cancel a task by business key. Implemented as a delete on rows matching (type, businessKey). No-op if no row matches.

    • deleteById

      void deleteById(String id)
      Cancel a task by id. No-op if the row no longer exists.
